title: Affine finite-free sheaf complex lifts to modules
statement: theorem affine_finiteFree_sheaf_complex_lift (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (hb : ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, N < i → IsZero (P.X i)) (hfree : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (P.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) : ∃ E : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, ∃ b : ℤ, E.IsStrictlyLE b ∧ (∀ j : ℤ, Module.Free A (E.X j) ∧ Module.Finite A (E.X j)) ∧ Nonempty ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A) (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A)) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj E ≅ P)

proof.text: Choose finite ranks and free module representatives for each sheaf term. Full faithfulness of tilde lifts conjugated differentials and faithfulness proves the complex equations.
The termwise isomorphism gives the complex isomorphism; the upper bound transfers by reflection of zero objects, and finite-free instances are immediate.
